page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; no margin notes; a centred heading in capitals with italic subtitle; then a verse block of lines.

main_text.p: {f}innoxius quanquam haud quidem perisse credendus est. Corporis qui demiacturam fecit, sed illi, in maiorem salutis cessit cumulum apud Deum iudicem. Neque enim dubium est, quin is iam summo uiuit olympo, unà cum iis, quorum sanguinem dominus ulturus est nimis fortassis cito, istorum quibusdam, quos terra hæc nimis diu inultos sustinet.
main_text.head: CARMINA QVAEDAM IN EIUS laudem reperta, apud Nicolaum Harlamensem.
main_text.p: Claustra Thomas Gallus primus qui laspa refor mat
main_text.l: Compulit hunc feruor domini conspargere semen
Illum quæ docceant pectus habere pium

page.notes: The first line of the verse block and the Latin "{f}" marker are uncertain. Lines of the verse are partly illegible in places; the word "docceant" and "laspa refor mat" are doubtful. The short printed words "Quantum" at the end is a catchword-like fragment; the marginal page number is not printed.
